name: Lessons — starter topics
description: A ready-made set of lesson topics, hand-written rather than generated. No videos are attached yet — that field is real and per-topic (packs.js's own schema makes it optional), so pointing any of these at a real recording later is a pack edit, not a code change. Each topic still unlocks and works on the honour button alone in the meantime, same as the module's own built-in defaults.

items.topic: Following a set of written instructions in order
